Auctioneera is delighted to present Lucca, Kilcoolishal, Glounthaune in Cork.

Welcome to Lucca, a splendid detached family residence set in the peaceful surroundings of Kilcoolishal, Glounthaune, Cork. This four-bedroom, four-bathroom home extends to approximately 220 sq. m. and offers a generous blend of modern comfort, flexible living space, and traditional charm. Approaching the property, you are greeted by an attractive façade with tasteful stone detailing, mature planting, a manicured lawn, and a neatly paved driveway, all contributing to the home’s strong kerb appeal.

Stepping inside, the ground floor opens into a welcoming entrance area and a spacious living room, creating an inviting setting for everyday relaxation and family gatherings. The layout continues through to a dedicated dining area and a well-appointed kitchen featuring integrated appliances, ample countertop space, and subtle pantry-style storage, providing a practical and stylish cooking environment. A second kitchen area and family room add excellent flexibility, while the sun room offers a bright and comfortable space overlooking the garden. A laundry room, additional storage, porch areas, and ground-floor bathroom facilities further enhance the practicality of the home.

Upstairs, the generously sized primary bedroom benefits from its own ensuite bathroom, offering a private and comfortable retreat. Three additional bedrooms provide strong accommodation for family members, guests, or home office use, with a large bathroom also positioned on this level. The overall layout is well suited to a growing family, with generous room proportions and multiple living spaces throughout.

The exterior of the home is equally appealing, with a delightful garden and patio area ideal for outdoor dining and relaxation. A key feature of the location is its convenience, with Little Island train station and East Gate both approximately a five-minute walk away, offering excellent connectivity to Cork city centre and nearby employment hubs. Local amenities, including schools, sports clubs, and shopping facilities, are also easily accessible, making this an ideal setting for families or  seeking a balance between convenience and tranquillity.

Lucca is an excellent choice for those seeking to trade up to a larger home, offering substantial accommodation, flexible living space, and a desirable Glounthaune setting. Its thoughtful layout and strong practical features make it an attractive option for discerning buyers.

Bright sun-filled interiors	
Charming garden outlook	
Walkable local amenities	
5-min Walk to Little Island train station and East Gate
